selection_rule: Three minimum sums of five recorded B2000 timings.total; cheapest new nx if only one nx, otherwise fourth cheapest; lexical ID tie-break
A2_rule: Uniform without replacement within k, counts from paired A0, no quality access; exclude only nominally uncertifiable geometry and record exclusions

variants.A2: reuse same cached ES stopping history/prefix; random subsets matching A0 per-k counts; NBI only missing subsets

frozen_scope: 4 scenarios only; no global inference; no equalization; no new coefficients, anchors or references
H: unchanged lattice_resolution(k): H5 k2..4, H2 k5..6
cost_estimation: All A2/A3 full-pipeline estimates use paired A0 time per recorded SLSQP iteration, inherited preparation and postprocessing. Actual unique added work is separate in execution_costs.json; attribution fields in ablation_costs.csv are explicitly nonadditive.
aggregation: Mean A2 random seeds within each instance first; median five replicas per scenario; focused summary median of four scenario medians. All relative changes paired to the same scenario/replica A0; no inference.
